blockdesc-kitchenrange-copper-*: Cooks on 2 burners at once. Takes a pot of food or a single food item per burner, and bakes bread and pies without burning them. Burns firewood, charcoal or coal.
blockdesc-kitchenrange-tinbronze-*: Cooks on 3 burners at once, 1.5x faster than a firepit. Bakes bread and pies without burning them. Fuel lasts 25% longer.
blockdesc-kitchenrange-iron-*: Cooks on 4 burners at once, 2x faster than a firepit. Bakes bread and pies without burning them. Fuel lasts 50% longer.
blockdesc-kilnoven-copper-*: Fires 4 raw clay items at once: tool molds, ingot molds, pots and other pottery. Needs fuel that burns at 650°C or more for molds.
blockdesc-kilnoven-tinbronze-*: Fires 6 raw clay items at once, 1.5x faster. Fuel lasts 25% longer.
blockdesc-kilnoven-iron-*: Fires 8 raw clay items at once, 2x faster. Fuel lasts 50% longer.
blockdesc-largepot-copper-*: Cooks up to 10 servings at once.
blockdesc-largepot-tinbronze-*: Cooks up to 14 servings at once.
blockdesc-largepot-iron-*: Cooks up to 20 servings at once.
fuel-notlit: {0} - light it with a firestarter or torch
smoke-choking: You're choking on smoke! Open the room up or add a chimney.
vent-smoky: Smoky! No chimney in a closed room (works 40% slower)
vent-choking: Room is full of smoke - it will hurt anyone inside!
